| kuberay_cluster_provisioned_duration_seconds | gauge | The time, in seconds, when a RayCluster's `RayClusterProvisioned` status transitions from false (or unset) to true | [`ray-operator/controllers/ray/metrics/ray_cluster_metrics.go`](https://github.com/ray-project/kuberay/blob/62c0f910a2b7f0601d977ffcc42a5d278896f962/ray-operator/controllers/ray/metrics/ray_cluster_metrics.go) |
| kuberay_job_execution_duration_seconds | gauge | Duration from when the RayJob CR’s JobDeploymentStatus transitions from Initializing to either the Retrying state or a terminal state, such as Complete or Failed.
